content:
Day One: Arrival in Tokyo
Thou shalt set foot upon the bustling streets of Edo
Visit the venerable Senso-ji temple in Asakusa
Stroll through Nakamise market and sample sweet taiyaki
Evening repose in a ryokan with tatami mats

Day Two: Tokyo Exploration
Morning pilgrimage to the Meiji Shrine amidst the forest
Afternoon wanderlust in Shibuya where the scramble doth pulse
Night ascent to Tokyo Tower for lantern-lit vistas

Day Three: Journey to Kyoto
Board the swift Shinkansen to the ancient capital
Upon arrival wander the Philosopher's Path
Contemplate the moss-covered stones of Ginkaku-ji
Evening tea ceremony in a machiya house

Day Four: Kyoto Temples
Dawn visit to Fushimi Inari with its myriad torii gates
Midday repose at Kinkaku-ji the Golden Pavilion
Afternoon wander the historic district of Gion
Should fortune favor thou may glimpse a geisha

Day Five: Nara Day Trip
Travel to Nara where deer doth roam free
Pay homage at Todai-ji housing the great Buddha
Stroll through Nara Park and feed the gentle creatures
Return to Kyoto for night's rest

Day Six: Osaka Adventures
Ride the rail to Osaka the kitchen of Japan
Explore Dotonbori's neon glow and taste takoyaki
Visit Osaka Castle standing proud amidst moats
Evening cruise upon the Okawa river

Day Seven: Hiroshima and Miyajima
Morning train to Hiroshima
Visit the Peace Memorial Park and Museum
Ferry to Miyajima to see the floating torii of Itsukushima
Return to Osaka for final night

Day Eight: Departure
Morning reflection amidst the gardens of Osaka Castle
Journey to Kansai International Airport
Farewell to the land of the rising sun with heart full of verse
